technical.summary: Strong trend structure (ADX, EMA alignment, Ichimoku) undermined by overbought conditions, negative MACD/Stoch crossovers, and momentum deceleration—moderate risk swing entry with elevated pullback probability.

fundamental.summary: EVRG shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 13 days present elevated volatility risk with no fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (26/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent congressional conviction and no recent news data limit conviction; neutral to weak sentiment setup.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (418.4), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and earnings in 13 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for EVRG.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong trend structure (ADX, EMA 50/200 alignment, Supertrend bullish) with contrarian buy signal in extreme fear zone (VIX 418.4) offers asymmetric risk/reward for swing traders willing to catch falling knife.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought momentum (RSI 21, Stochastic), confirmed MACD/Stoch bearish crossovers, earnings volatility in 13 days, crisis macro backdrop (VIX, rising USD, flat yield curve), zero fundamental/smart money support, and price below both 50/200 EMAs create compounding headwinds that invalidate technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Strong trend structure (ADX, EMA alignment) offers technical appeal, but overbought momentum (RSI 21, Stoch) combined with confirmed bearish MACD/Stoch crossovers signals imminent pullback risk.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings volatility in 13 days combined with crisis macro backdrop (VIX 418.4, rising USD, flat yield curve) and zero fundamental/smart money support creates compounding downside risk that invalidates technical strength.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
